name: orchestrator
description: Delegate tasks to another CLI's agent as a subagent, as T3 Code does: Antigravity's agy over ACP, in its own session, under a runtime mode the plugin enforces, with a shared daemon that wakes the session when a task ends.

maxRuntimeMode.title: Runtime mode ceiling
maxRuntimeMode.description: The broadest runtime mode a delegated task may run in, and the one it gets when it names none: approval-required (reads only), auto-accept-edits (edits inside the session folder) or full-access (edits and commands).

taskMinutes.title: Task limit (minutes)
taskMinutes.description: How long a delegated task may run before it is stopped.

agyPath.title: agy CLI path
agyPath.description: Absolute path of the agy executable; leave empty to look on PATH, then in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.
